context: Asuka lectures on art history transitions.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: art lecture; formal vocabulary (自体/とともに/以来/以降/いずれ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 絵画は、技術とともに進化しました。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 色自体の使い方も、変わったんですか?
lines.en: Did the use of color itself change too?
lines.style: soft thoughtful woman voice, gentle warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、近代以来、自由になりました。
lines.en: Yes, since the modern era it became free.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ある時代以降、抽象画も増えましたよね。
lines.en: From a certain era on, abstract art increased too.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その時代以降、表現自体が広がりました。
lines.en: From that era on, expression itself widened.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いずれ、また新しい形が出ますか?
lines.en: Will new forms eventually emerge again?
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm curious delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いずれ、時代とともに生まれるでしょう。
lines.en: Eventually, they'll arise along with the times.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 芸術自体が、時とともに歩むんですね。
lines.en: Art itself walks along with time.
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm tender realization throughout
